name: Native Performance Optimization
purpose: Profile and optimize native CPU, GPU, and memory performance: cycle-level hotspots, cache-miss behavior, allocation churn, data-layout efficiency, and GPU pipeline stalls, with every claim backed by profiler captures before and after.
inputs: Performance budget: frame-time target, p50/p99 latency SLAs, memory ceiling
Reproducible workload: benchmark scene, trace capture, or load script
Build profile under test: compiler, flags, LTO/PGO status, target microarchitecture
Profiler access on the target machine (perf, Tracy, VTune, RenderDoc, NSight)
outputs: Performance specification document with budgets, captures, and per-fix deltas
Optimized implementation with layout, allocation, and threading changes isolated per commit
Benchmark harness addition so CI tracks p99 frame time on every merge
stop_conditions: p99 frame time within budget on the slowest declared target with hitch ceiling held
L1-D miss rate below 3% on hot loops and steady-state allocation churn at zero
